test_checks.description: Activation with KYC-verified, a valid dealer code, and MNP-success transitions PENDING_KYC -> ACTIVE and appends a StateTransition row.
Activation with unverified KYC is rejected with reason code KYC_UNVERIFIED; subscription remains PENDING_KYC.
Activation with dealer code DEALER-FAIL (and, independently, any unknown/unseeded dealer code) is rejected with reason code DEALER_INVALID.
Activation with the MNP-fail flag is rejected with reason code MNP_FAILED.
Activating a subscription not in PENDING_KYC (already ACTIVE) raises InvalidSubscriberStateException, checked before any rule evaluation.
Two pending registrations for the same mobile number racing to activate: only one reaches ACTIVE, the other is rejected via the DB-level partial unique index on UPDATE.
POST /api/admin/plans (admin role) creates a draft plan version and returns HTTP 201.
POST /api/admin/plans/{id}/publish publishes a draft and returns HTTP 200 with published: true.
PUT /api/admin/plans/{id} on an already-published version returns HTTP 409 with an immutability reason code.
GET /api/admin/plans returns the full version history including superseded versions.

A non-admin principal receives HTTP 403 on create/list/publish/update (test_non_admin_receives_403_for_create_and_list is parametrized over 2 cases [create, list] -> collects as 2 items; combined with the 2 dedicated publish/update tests, 4 items total. Verified via isolated collect run, not assumed.

Full backend test suite, lint, and strict typecheck all clean together (regression gate covering Groups A+B+C+D combined). Also covers grp-d-13's no-stray-DB-file concern implicitly via a clean git status after the run.
